character: Europe's largest skiable glacier (6 km long). Summer skiing June-September. Legendary snowpark. 220 km winter pistes.
name: Les Deux Alpes
description: 200km of pistes, 53 lifts, dominated by the Mont-de-Lans glacier (3,600m) — one of Europe's largest glacier ski domains with year-round skiing. Known for: the most extensive summer skiing operation in France (June-July), Europe's highest snowpark (3,200m), ice diving (the frozen lake on the glacier), and one of the best bike parks in the Alps (summer). The Vénéon valley base village is purpose-built at 1,650m. Also covers Mont-de-Lans and Vénosc villages below.

lift_pass_pricing.note: Summer skiing pass separate (glacier pass). Year-round ski area — one of very few in Europe with June-July glacier operations.

suitability.beginners: Good — dedicated beginners area at 1,650m and higher on the glacier. The blue run from the mid-station is 5km long. ESF with English instructors.
suitability.intermediates: Very good — 200km with long blues from the glacier down to the valley. The run from 3,600m to 1,300m is a 20km continuous descent. High-altitude blues are consistently snow-sure.
suitability.advanced: Good — glacier blacks, steep face under the Diable lift, and the 'Tortue' off-piste zone. The Vallée de la Gorge area for steep tree skiing.
suitability.freeriders: Excellent — the glacier snowpark is Europe's highest, and the Diable sector has famous off-piste itineraries. The Béranger valley descent.
suitability.summer_skiing: June to July on the Mont-de-Lans glacier (3,200-3,600m). Most extensive in France alongside Val Thorens and Tignes.
